# API Response Information

Below is the response from an API call. To help you understand the data, I've provided:

1. A detailed description of all fields in the response structure
2. The complete API response

## Response Structure

> Content-Type: application/json

- **data**: No comments found. (Type: object)
  - **data.mealAssistanceItems**: 可选助餐服务列表 (Type: array)
    - **data.mealAssistanceItems[].gmServiceCode**: 助餐服务编码 (Type: string)
    - **data.mealAssistanceItems[].gmServiceName**: 助餐服务名称 (Type: string)
    - **data.mealAssistanceItems[].serviceItems**: 服务内容 (Type: array of string)
    - **data.mealAssistanceItems[].selected**: 默认选中助餐服务 (Type: boolean)
    - **data.mealAssistanceItems[].enable**: 是否可选 (Type: boolean)
    - **data.mealAssistanceItems[].unusableReason**: 不可用原因, 1: 送达时间仅XX可享，2: 专人服务需提前4h预约 (Type: string)
- **message**: No comments found. (Type: string)
- **traceId**: No comments found. (Type: string)
